info.name: Livestock ERP - Farm locations and farm information
info.description: Independent House/Barn and Pen/Cage/Pond CRUD, plus farm information entry with IDs. Set access_token and run in order on a development database. Requires two accessible active branches, setup.branches.view, setup.house_barns and setup.pen_cage_ponds CRUD permissions, setup.farm-information CRUD and farms.view. Names are unique per branch within each master. Pens may have a parent barn or be standalone. Referenced masters are protected even after farm soft deletion, so cleanup deactivates retained fixtures. No pre-existing business records are modified. All requests have live saved examples. Updates use POST.
